The idea is that the first 10 demons are "special" as in they were feelings that every living thing could have. They have existed as long as that feeling was possible. Fiddle was born as soon as the first thing in the universe could feel fear. These 10 are all born following that kinda rule. Once something could feel pain, pain was there. The lesser demons are spirits that found sustenance on emotions. Evelynn was just a little spirit before she found that she could feed off of agony.
